what: The panel is cut by a mask whose four edges are quadratic curves. The center control point moves first and the corners follow .2s later, so the mask’s head swells round as it rises from below (up, 1.25s power2.out) and reveals the panel, while the panel (or the photo inside) settles from 1.3x to 1x over 1.875s expo.out. The accompanying text (sub) appears after .5s, staggered .25s, over .625s. The down type is a drawer: the bottom edge of a mask attached to the top droops down round from the center and covers the panel (1s power2.inOut, corners .1s late, and it retracts in the same shape via fx:close). The box type is a center box of 48%×72% whose four edges swell outward and spread to the full screen (2s power3.inOut), which is where the first video grows.

options.look: up (default — fills from the bottom) · down (drawer curtain coming down from the top, default on: manual) · box (unfolds from a center box)
options.on: scroll (default — once when even one line of the panel enters the screen) · load (as soon as attached) · manual (when fx:play is sent)
options.dur · ease · lag · delay: Curtain length · curve · corner delay · start delay. Defaults up 1.25 · power2.out · .2 · .25, down 1 · power2.inOut · .1 · 0, box 2 · power3.inOut · .2 · .25
options.sweep: At 1 the top-edge control point drifts from left to right while the mask fills, so the top rises at a slant (photo frame type)
options.scale · scale-dur · scale-ease: Scale, length and curve at which the panel (or media child) starts to sink. Default 1.3 · veil length × 1.5 · expo.out — 1 turns it off
options.w · h: Initial box size for the box type (relative to the panel), default .48 · .72
options.depth: For up/down types, how many multiples of the plate height below (above) the curtain head starts from, default 1 — at 2 the head swells longer and lands later (original wording)
options.sub-dur · sub-delay · sub-each · sub-y ·: Length, delay, order, initial downward offset (px) and curve for the attached text appearing. Defaults: veil × .5 · .5 · .25 · 0 · power2.out
options.close-dur: Length of fx:close for down Type, default curtain × .67
options.keep: If 1, the curtain (clip-path) is not lifted even after fully opening — it stays as a curtain with a fully filled end shape, like the original photo cell. By default it is lifted so shadows and overflow are not clipped
options.observe: With parent, on: scroll detection uses the parent (the header group holding the title) instead of the panel — like the original js-show-text, the curtain opens even if text beside the title enters the screen first
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Photo sinking within the curtain (if none, the panel itself sinks)
options.[data-fx-part=sub]: Secondary text and buttons that appear in sequence after the curtain opens
options.fx:play · fx:close · fx:start · fx:done: Open · (down) send Close / start Open (detail.delay = Delay in seconds) · fully open · fully closed receive — listens for fx:start when floating a sibling text outside the panel in sync with the curtain

note: The original path formula (center control point y from 1+1 to 0, corners later by lag) was rewritten in the same form. Once fully open the clip-path is removed so shadows and overflow are not cut off (the down type keeps it). The drawer (down) uses, as in the original, .75s · lag .1 · close .5s on large screens and 1s · lag .05 · close .75s on narrow screens, chosen by an option.
